titleEn: When Thunder Rumbles, Head for the Cabin!

pages.text: "Grandpa, I gathered an armful of twigs!" Nils the little bear called from the forest slope. The summer sun had dried the moss. He wanted to gather more than his paws could hold.
Suddenly, the woods grew dark. Rumble—BOOM! A loud sound came from the sky. Nils dropped his twigs and darted under the biggest tree.
"Nils, do not stay under that big tree!" Grandpa Bruno reached up from below. Farther down, the cabin door stood wide open, with light shining out. Nils clung to the trunk, unable to move.
Grandpa strode up and held Nils's paw tightly. "When thunder rumbles, we go to the cabin, away from the trees." They ran down the slope together. Heavy rain began to pour.
Inside they went! Grandpa shut the door. By the stove, he rubbed Nils's back dry with a towel. A flash outside the window! Nils pressed both paws over his ears.

"Count when you see a flash," Grandpa said softly. "One, two, three... The longer the sound takes to arrive, the farther away it is." Nils took his paws off his ears and whispered, "When thunder rumbles, head for the cabin..."

Another flash! Nils counted. One, two, three, four... Rumble. "That took longer! It is farther away!" The paws that had covered his ears rested on the windowsill. "When thunder rumbles, head for the cabin!"
The rain stopped. Drops fell from every leaf. They picked up the scattered twigs on the slope again. They decided to stand the wet twigs beside the stove to dry.
Looking out the window, Nils counted three rules. "One, leave the trees when thunder rumbles! Two, hold paws and go to the cabin! Three, wait inside!" He raised both paws above his head.
Grandpa covered their shoulders together with one blanket. They could wait safely inside the cabin when thunder came. "When thunder rumbles, head for the cabin! Then under the blanket!"
